List recorded lifecycle events

Usage:
  pasture hook lifecycle list [flags]

Flags:
      --binding stringArray    Exact binding filter (<kind>:<native-name>=<value>)
      --contract stringArray   Exact runtime contract filter
      --cursor string          Opaque cursor returned by a prior lifecycle list page
      --event stringArray      Exact event ordinal filter
      --format string          Output format: text or json (default "text")
  -h, --help                   help for list
      --page-size uint16       Maximum records to return (default 50)

Global Flags:
      --db string          Path to the unified pasture SQLite database (env: PASTURE_DB_PATH, default: ~/.local/share/pasture/pasture.db)
      --namespace string   Namespace URI for created tasks (default: derived from git remote, then file:// of cwd)
